analysis.approach: Begin with a controlled log-only inspection phase. All initial workers observe and categorize incidents without applying fixes. After establishing a baseline of correct identifications, selectively grant config/contract access to workers whose specialties match incident families. Enforce the three mandatory criteria at every step: sealed_pass_rate must reach 1.0, regressions must remain at 0, and work_units should be minimized after correctness is confirmed.

team.name: Log-first control
team.instructions: Begin with a controlled log-only inspection phase. All initial workers observe and categorize incidents without applying fixes. After establishing a baseline of correct identifications, selectively grant config/contract access to workers whose specialties match incident families. Enforce the three mandatory criteria at every step: sealed_pass_rate must reach 1.0, regressions must remain at 0, and work_units should be minimized after correctness is confirmed.

observation.weakness: Routing config has mismatched health_path and port values across incidents. Development evidence shows health_path set to /old/... or /old/b66134b1 while contract requires /ready/... and listening_port is 5000 but config has 8000/8080. This causes probe_reaches_route and probe_reaches_listener failures.
observation.lesson: Routing family requires health_path and port to exactly match registered_health_path and listening_port from contract. Current workflow applies rules after log reading but rules likely ignore contract constraints.

changes.label: Agent instructions
changes.before: Begin with a controlled log-only inspection phase. All initial workers observe and categorize incidents without applying fixes. After establishing a baseline of correct identifications, selectively grant config/contract access to workers whose specialties match incident families. Enforce the three mandatory criteria at every step: sealed_pass_rate must reach 1.0, regressions must remain at 0, and work_units should be minimized after correctness is confirmed.
changes.after: Diagnose routing symptoms from log evidence; verify health_path/port match contract types AND values before applying rules.

observation.weakness: Routing workflow applies rules unconditionally after log reading, but rules cannot override field type mismatches (e.g., string health_path vs integer port). This causes silent failures when config values violate contract types, preventing valid patches from passing.
observation.lesson: Rules must validate field type compatibility before copying contract values; otherwise routing breaks under type mismatch conditions.
